title: input_parity_draw and input_parity_draw_wide are the only .t1 captures without .log.bin siblings
evidence:

(All 49 other demos appear as an adjacent pair: 'diff --git a/goldens/<demo>.log.bin b/goldens/<demo>.log.bin' immediately followed by 'diff --git a/goldens/<demo>.t1 b/goldens/<demo>.t1'; these two .t1 files are back-to-back with no intervening .log.bin entry anywhere in the 102-file chunk.)
detail: 51 .t1 captures but 49 .log.bin logs; only the input-parity demos lack log siblings. If those demos are supposed to emit logs, golden log captures are missing.
recommended_fix: Confirm input-parity demos intentionally produce no log capture; add the two .log.bin goldens or document the exception beside the golden set.
